pitch_detail.notes: The right of the pair of cracks on the left side of The Monk's South Face.
The hardest climbing on the route comes higher up.
Start at the lowest point of The Monk's South Face and climb the central line.
Pass left of the prominent roof at mid-face — the defining move of the route.
Continue up the face to the top of The Monk.
Start at the large ledge near the right side of the lowest part of The Monk's South Face.
Zigzag up the right side of the face. Long slings essential to manage drag.
Final pitch to the top of The Monk.
Broken ridge crest; a couple of protectable moves per pitch.
After descending ~400 ft below the summit, cross a dike; the crux sections are here.
Final airy, exposed scramble to the true summit; rope may be welcome.
